summary: Preserve native standard pins during fleet adoption

delivery.outcome: Publish a fleet adopter that preserves native standard pins and refuses legacy manifest creation over partial locked adoption, with regression tests and independent protected merge.
nonGoals: No edits to fleet target repositories or deployed controllers
No publisher policy changes, credential changes or foreign scope takeover
No substitute native bootstrap or conformance claim

architecture.decision: Detect native or locked adoption during planning and recheck immediately before any fleet writes; preserve legacy profile header updates and additive native adoption without version mutation.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded fleet guard; no existing target repository is modified.

validation.evidence: Native manifest and lock bytes are preserved during rejected update or stale plan; legacy scaffold updates remain supported.
All tests and native governance pass on the exact delivered head.
